title: GPT-OSS 20B ran my personal agent for a week: 0 frontier APIs, 312 tasks, 97.4% first-shot tool calls
body:
I started with an open-source assistant harness and did something stupid:

I stripped out every cloud API call and made a GPT-OSS responsible for the entire agent loop.

here's what happened over 7 days running on my m5 macbook PRO from a compiled 12GB binary (available upon request):

93.2% completed without me taking over

97.4% first-attempt schema-valid tool calls

I started the week trying to find where GPT-OSS 20B would fail.

I ended it cancelling perplexity computer.

submitted by /u/rasheed106
